name: Vesna
title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
description: Commander of the Druzhna and the Tsaritsa's keen blade.

skills.name: Vila Blade Dance
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to trample opponents in front of her.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along her path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: The Art of Victory
skills.description:
Calls forth Spirit Blades passed down through generations of the Vila to deal AoE Anemo DMG, then switches to the Armed for Action mode and gains 2 stacks of Sword Essence.

Armed for Action
DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks become Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional Anemo DMG. Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of Sword Essence.
Vesna can consume Sword Essence to unleash the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword, which deals to the opponent Anemo DMG.
Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1 to Lv. 3 max, for more Anemo DMG. Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon Spirit Blades which deal Anemo DMG.
Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or when she has used Windborne Sword at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining Sword Essence she has accrued.
Additionally, when in this mode, Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt with the Spirit Blades becomes Anemo DMG that is also considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.

Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Final Hit DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 2 Spirit Blade Stellar Swirl DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Stellar Swirl DMG
Windborne Sword Lv. 3 Spirit Blade Final Hit Stellar Swirl DMG

skills.name: For the Tsaritsa!
skills.description: Summons multiple Spirit Blades, dealing AoE Anemo DMG. Also gains a stack of Sword Essence.

passives.name: Rite of Spring's Procession
passives.description:
After Vesna uses the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword or the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!, she also gains 1 stack of Disciplinary Action which lasts 20s. Max 6 stacks, and the duration of each stack is independent of the others'.
When she has Disciplinary Action stacks active, the Spirit Blades summoned by Vesna will deal DMG equal to (100% + 10% × Disciplinary Action stack count) of the original DMG instead. All active stacks of Disciplinary Action are cleared when Vesna uses the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory or when she leaves the field.

passives.name: Truth Prevails
passives.description:
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Vesna will gain the corresponding effect based on the Elemental Type of her party members:
· For every Cryo or Anemo character in her current party, Vesna's ATK increases by 6%; and
· For every character of all other Elemental Types in her current party, Vesna's Elemental Mastery increases by 25 instead.

passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Splendid Prelude
passives.description:
When party members trigger Cryo Swirl, it will be changed to a Stellar Swirl reaction, and party members' Base DMG for the Stellar Swirl will be increased based on Vesna's ATK. Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar Swirl DMG by 0.7%. The maximum DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
After a party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction nearby, Vesna enters the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s.

passives.name: The Grand Circuit
passives.description:
Holding on Sprint or Jump when Vesna is not in combat will cause her to enter the Coursing state.

Coursing
Continuously consumes Stamina to hover in mid-air. Sprinting or tapping Jump to go higher expends additional Stamina. Including the hold on Jump that triggers Coursing, Vesna can go higher up to 3 times in each instance of the Coursing state.

Additionally, in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai), when Vesna is switched onto the field while the currently active party member is in mid-air and not in combat, she will immediately enter the Coursing state and regenerate 50 Stamina. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: Winter's Farewell Feast
constellations.description:
When in the Armed for Action mode, Vesna can unleash Windborne Sword at the highest level 4 times instead of 3. Also, each time she enters the Armed for Action mode, she will not consume Sword Essence the first time she uses Windborne Sword at the highest level.
Additionally, Vesna deals 20% increased Stellar Swirl reaction DMG when in the Armed for Action mode.

constellations.name: Kolo of Spring's Arrival
constellations.description:
The Ascension Talent Rite of Spring's Procession is enhanced: Vesna gains the maximum number of Disciplinary Action stacks when she enters Armed for Action mode. Vesna's ATK is increased by 40% when she has maximum Disciplinary Action stacks.
You must unlock the Ascension Talent "Rite of Spring's Procession" to gain access to the above effects.

constellations.name: Winter's Last Offering
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Glory to Our Forebears
constellations.description: The Ascension Talent Truth Prevails is enhanced: Its ATK and Elemental Mastery bonuses increase to 3 times their original values.

constellations.name: The Nobleborn's Charge
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Unwavering Ardor
constellations.description:
Tapping on Normal Attack or Elemental Skill in the 5s after Vesna uses Windborne Sword at its highest level will unleash the secret Vila ability Windborne Sword: Transpose, dealing Anemo DMG at 150% of Vesna's ATK as well as summoning Spirit Blades which deal an additional instance of Anemo DMG at 200% of Vesna's ATK. If Vesna is in the Armed for Action mode, she will also summon a wind pinion to perform Coordinated Attacks against opponents.
Additionally, Vesna's Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt is elevated by 20%.

outfits.name: Spring's Bond, Winter's Oath
outfits.description: Vesna's outfit. Slightly modified by Vesna herself from the basic Snezhnayan Druzhna uniform. Still, attractiveness is one thing, and costs are quite another. As such, Vesna's request for a larger-scale uniform overhaul has not been approved to this day.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Hello, dear friend. Commander Vesna of the Druzhna. The pleasure is all mine. The gun salute and honor guard are in position and ready for your grand welcome. Of course, if you're not one for fanfare, I've also arranged a more private welcome ceremony. Come on, this way~

voices.title: Chat: Service
voices.text: The Druzhna takes orders only from the Tsaritsa, so they cannot be at your beck and call. But Vesna the Vila is happy to be of service, my dear friend.

voices.title: Chat: Happiness
voices.text: Isn't this outfit just gorgeous? It was a personal gift from Her Majesty. Hehe, that's right, feast your eyes.

voices.title: Chat: Efficiency
voices.text: What paperwork? Oh, I finished it ages ago — flew through it. Now it's time to get out on patrol. C'mon, let's go~

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Fae can absolutely catch colds. When they get wet, it's important to flap them dry right away. T—The wings, I mean.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: In the snow, the slightest imperfection in your camouflage can be fatal. So tread carefully, dear friend.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: I know what you're thinking — and I agree. My wings look their most dazzling in the sun.

voices.title: When It's Windy
voices.text: Ah... Hehe, very nice. The Vila just love a good breeze.

voices.title: In the Desert
voices.text: Just wondering... When are we heading back to Snezhnaya again?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: A new day! Good morning, Snezhnograd!

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Off we go to Podvorye Restaurant, come on! My treat, of course. As always!

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: The Korolevskiy Troupe is debuting a new show tonight. Featuring Prima Donna Vodyanitsa's high soprano, Miss Odette latest choreography... and a few "new friends."

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Pssst... You can't be asleep already. Come out for a late-night walk? The aurora is great tonight!

voices.title: About Vesna: Magic Weapon
voices.text: See these little things flying around me? They're my magic weapons, my own creations. Each one is a blend of elemental energy and my own will, so they've inherited something of my personality as well. Which is to say, it's possible that they might pester you to play with them. Don't mind them... Though of course, if you have time, please indulge them, hehe!

voices.title: About Vesna: Commander
voices.text: Who says a commander needs to be strict and imposing? Pshh, that's for people with no presence. I don't need it~ I think we're quite similar in that regard.

voices.title: About Us: The Truth
voices.text: I get it, I get it. There are all sorts of rumors flying around about me, and you want to know the truth. Well, that's fine, we have plenty of time for that. But in return, I want to know the truth about you, too, down to the very last detail.

voices.title: About Us: Company
voices.text: I don't like the idea of "accompanying" someone on a journey. It sounds romantic at first, but when you think about it, the word "accompany" makes one person the protagonist and the other a mere sidekick.\nThe truth is, every step we take is our own, as are the things we experience and the ways we grow along the way. So, I won't say that I'm "accompanying" you on your journey — rather that I'm glad to have the pleasure of your company on what happens to be, for now, a shared journey. Think of it like this... you're walking along, minding your own business, then at some point you turn your head and notice: Oh wow! Haha, look at that — seems like we're both going the same way!

voices.title: About the Stellar Linchpin
voices.text: Stellar Linchpins are beautifully designed. Absolutely a collector's item. Actually, Moon Wheels aren't bad, either. Always wanted to get my hands on one. As for Visions, though... Not interested at the moment, sorry.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Oh, you mean this old thing? Beautiful, isn't it? It's a family heirloom, you know. Much, much older than I am. A true antique, in fact, worthy of a museum. Sometimes I use it as a magic wand, sometimes as a pointer when giving a class, and sometimes as a commander's baton... Ah, just look at me, giving it the chance to relive its glory days at this ripe old age, rather than locking it up in a bank vault somewhere to gather dust. My ancestors would be lining up to sing my praises if they knew!

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: The Frostfairy Flower is a thing of beauty and resilience, surviving in spite of the brutally cold environment. It also has a very distinctive pattern. I like gazing at it through half-closed eyes as I shake my head, hehe — it creates a dreamy effect, like looking through a kaleidoscope. That said, I'd advise doing that in a private place with no one else around.

voices.title: About the Tsaritsa: Loyalty
voices.text: I've apprehended far too many self-righteous fools who wish to oppose Her Majesty. Their grand speeches about conquest? All show and no substance. They have neither the strategy to launch a rebellion nor the competence to see it through. Compared to those would-be revolutionaries... No, I take that back. They don't even deserve to be mentioned in the same breath as Her Majesty.\nMy point is, serving the Tsaritsa is not only my duty as a Vila. It's also my personal choice as Vesna.

voices.title: About the Tsaritsa: Compassion
voices.text: Her Majesty always speaks the word "compassion" with an icy sting to it. She says it's a curse imposed upon the gods by the Heavenly Principles, not genuine love. But I very much disagree. Whenever I return from a campaign against monsters, Her Majesty adds "rest well" at the end of her personal decree. And after the Ruler of Life's power was reclaimed, she sensed how disappointed I was, despite my efforts to hide it, and sent the unclaimed portion back to me...\nSomeone in her position has no obligation to do any of these things. At the risk of sounding presumptuous, I've always believed that the question of whether a god is truly loving can only be answered by their people. So why shouldn't my verdict count?

voices.title: About Danica: Childhood
voices.text: Oh, dearest Miss Danica... Don't be fooled by her serious and brooding demeanor. We got up to all kinds of mischief together when we were little... Like the time we plotted to steal Teacher's mask right off of his face. We made it all the way up onto his shoulders before getting caught! Sure, we didn't quite pull it off, and yes, we got punished — had to stand at attention on a frozen lake for hours... Ah, but anyway, that's besides the point! She was the one who came up with that crazy idea in the first place! She was every bit the troublemaker I was. And now she gives me that look all the time, like she's the adult and I'm the child. I mean, puh-lease. I'm actually the older one.

voices.title: About Danica: Arguments
voices.text: We have good intel that certain suspects are using bizarre events like "Quarreling Contests" as a front to conduct illegal business transactions, the rowdy crowd serving as a handy distraction... And so, it falls to me to intervene.\nTo that end, I've taken the liberty of signing Danica up. She's a master of deadpan takedowns and hitting people where it hurts. No one can out-quarrel her, so she'll definitely buy me tons of time.\nCounting on you, Danica!

voices.title: About The Captain
voices.text: I always remember how he looked from behind. So sturdy and reliable, like a steadfast mountain. I never imagined there'd come a day when that mountain would fall. Or at least... I didn't think it would come so soon. He always used to say, "In a real war, you don't get the chance to say goodbye." Of all the ways to prove it to me... Surely, he could have given me one last chance before the end, but he didn't...\nI'll never let that go, Teach.

voices.title: About The Jester
voices.text: Some people skip through the world with a pep in their step, most of them full of hope for what tomorrow will bring. Not him. His steps are always slow and heavy. I always felt that he and my teacher were similar people. I guess it's because they both hide unimaginable sorrow beneath a mask, bearing all the pain of the past on their shoulders.

voices.title: About The Rooster
voices.text: Mr. Mayor speaks with such eloquence and composure at the Snezhnograd Veche, and he makes it look so effortless. He can really command the room.

voices.title: About Regrator
voices.text: Now, I'm not saying that a Druzhna Commander's salary is low, but it can get a little tight if you're an avid collector who also enjoys treating people to meals... No, oh, no no no, I didn't mean it like that! I wasn't finished. Ever since I can remember, my family's spare funds have been managed by the Northland Bank, and thanks to Mr. Pantalone, the compound returns have grown our wealth quite substantially. Basically, I don't have to worry about money at all. So next time we're out, it's still my treat, and no need to hold back!

voices.title: About Marionette
voices.text: Sandrone fully embodies what it means to be a lady. Her words may be highly aggressive in nature, but her impeccable logic makes it impossible to find fault with her... Hehe, it really fascinates me. I must learn how she does it.

voices.title: About Mitya
voices.text: Mitya often joins me for hijinks. He's forever sneaking out of the Armory, and the three of us always have a blast! Why "three," you ask? Because there's me, Mitya, and his ever-so-clever scarf.

voices.title: About Vodyanitsa
voices.text: Every one of Miss Vodyanitsa's songs is simply beautiful. I love hearing them live. At times they fill me with joy, at other times they move me to tears, just like everyone else in the audience. Sometimes, everyone stays behind after the show ends and suddenly breaks into song together. Well, funnily enough, I just so happen to have a conductor's baton in my hand. And even more funnily, I've noticed on several occasions that Miss Vodyanitsa quietly blends into the crowd after changing out of her stage outfit, puts on a hat, and sings a harmony for the group.

voices.title: About Odette
voices.text: I have to be honest — every time I see Miss Odette at a court gathering, I find myself stealing a glance at her constantly. After all, as well as being a member of the Fatui, she has a special alter ego that makes her hard to ignore... Hmm? Why, her role as prima ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe, of course. What did you think I meant?

voices.title: About Alyosha
voices.text: I get it, I really do. I mean, how could any little puppy resist the urge to chase a pretty butterfly through the "howling" winds? Hmm... Maybe I'll steal Danica's breakfast and feed it to Tugarin, then ask Alyosha to put in a good word for me, so he doesn't come charging at me the moment he sees me...

voices.title: More About Vesna: I
voices.text: Hehe, so how would you like to get to know me? Surely, we're not just going to chat? Well, that's no fun... Hmm... Can't we play a game of "Truth or Dare" instead?

voices.title: More About Vesna: II
voices.text: We Druzhna are the Tsaritsa's personal guard, answering directly to Her Majesty. Our duties aren't just limited to neutralizing monster threats and going into battle — they extend beyond military affairs. In all matters concerning Her Majesty's authority and honor, we are bound to answer her call unconditionally and remove all obstacles from her path.\nHowever, Her Majesty is inevitably spread a little thin while the grand endeavor against the Heavenly Principles is ongoing. So until the dust has settled, I am more than happy to assist her with the fun stuff— Ahem, I mean, the more trivial matters, such as ribbon-cutting ceremonies and attending banquets on her behalf.

voices.title: More About Vesna: III
voices.text: I have an eclectic collection of treasures. Jewelry, ancient books, oil paintings... Anything that makes me happy is worth adding to the collection. And I have to have it the moment I lay eyes upon it, not a single second can be wasted! You know the saying, don't you? "A spoon is dear when lunch time is near." If you wait until after the initial thrill has passed before acquiring it, it loses it appeal. So, if I want it now, I must have it now.

voices.title: More About Vesna: IV
voices.text: After Tsar Monomakh's sacrifice, Snezhnaya went through a period of great turmoil. My forebears stood firmly by the Tsaritsa's side. So, as I stand here on their shoulders today, do I really possess the strength to do justice to their legacy? Hehe, I've put words to the question in your mind, haven't I? Well, now it's your turn to voice the answer that's in mine. Go ahead~

voices.title: More About Vesna: V
voices.text:
On the eve of the battle against the Ruler of Death, I extracted "Seals of Life" from many people. Everyone's definition of a beautiful memory varies. Some cherish sitting around the fireplace with family, chatting idly. Some fondly remember sitting alone by a train window, watching the aurora drift silently across the night sky. Still others are satisfied simply pulling a sled out for some ice fishing...
Those memories are like iridescent bubbles, filled with an effervescence and vitality that just makes you want to exclaim: "Ah, it's so good to be alive!"
Yet, those so-called heavenly beings can crush those bubbles with ease, without giving a single word of explanation. What gives them that right?
From that moment on, for me, the fight against the Heavenly Principles was no longer solely about assisting Her Majesty.

voices.title: Vesna's Hobbies
voices.text: When I was very young, my family arranged for me to take painting, dance, and singing classes. As I got a little older, I took up fencing, horse riding, and the like, hehe... More recently, I've been getting into opera, theater, and collecting my little treasures... In short, the word "bored" doesn't exist in my dictionary.

voices.title: Vesna's Troubles
voices.text: Don't listen to Danica's nonsense — there is absolutely nothing wrong with my driving skills. It's called being one with the vehicle! Just wait till my driving ban is lifted. I'll take you for a spin!

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: When it's so cold out, there's nothing cozier than gathering everyone together for some nice hot stew! Tell you what — I'll host, and you and Paimon can bring along some cooking ingredients. Anything you like will do~

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: Hehe! I'm slipping all those annoying veggies onto Danica's plate! Ugh... but they always come right back to me...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Oh, don't mind if I do! I'm going to savor every last bite.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Mmm... Quite a feat of culinary ingenuity... I think I'll take another bite.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Oof... I'm sorry, I already ate! But let me box them up for Danica~

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Ding-dong! The moment has arrived! You have no idea how hard it was for me to hold it in yesterday... But I had to, because saying it early is bad luck — you might get swallowed up by a snowstorm! Now, I can finally say it: Happy Birthday, my dear friend. May you stand as strong as the birch tree, never defeated by the wind and snow.\nAlright, that part's done. Next, tradition dictates that I've got to give our birthday superstar a few gentle tugs on the ear...

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: First lesson in boot camp: Only those who do not stand firm and do not yield to the wind and snow are qualified to stand guard by Her Majesty's side.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Second lesson in boot camp: Your sword arm must never tremble.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Third lesson in boot camp: We do not weep before our foes.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: You, dear friend, have taught me a lesson from beyond boot camp: To reserve a soft touch with which to embrace those I defend with my sword after the blizzard has died down.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Form up!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Salute.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Raise your swords!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Coming through~

voices.title: Elemental Skill: V
voices.text: More where that came from.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: VI
voices.text: Kindest regards.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Haha, alright. Let's play!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Locked on — no escape!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: For the Tsaritsa!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Hoho, another piece for my grand collection!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: One for you, one for me, one for Her Majesty, and another for me! None for Danica, hehe!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Well, lookee here!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: A commander stays on the field.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Don't worry, I'll dodge the rest...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Ahem... Just a temporary setback...

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Fall back. The Druzhna will take it from here.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Don't push yourself, my dear friend.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: My wings... are clipped...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Long live... the Tsaritsa...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: I'm not in pain... just denial...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Excuse me?

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Huh?

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Very bold!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: How rude!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Time for a patrol~

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: I hope you have something fun planned!

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: At your service, commander...
